author: Akien
prose:
well only one box (hex) even has DSP capabilities. but I have been thinking about the fact that cairn is a lab for doing research, and if I tried to build 100K cognative columns in software, that would mean at least a million data base calls per second. i think that we can't do that with our current approach, so if we did build that, we'd have to sort how to break it up. and this was the first thing to come our way that touched on distributing llm cognition. so i was looking for ideas there. theoretical because we can't split up in the same way since we're not DSP based. but what i did come up, based on your comment about how they're broken up, is that my brain is already broken up into 'specialized areas'. when we do break this up, we'll need to do the same. and at that point it will be necessary to serve db reads from the local host, not over the bus.

[on capture:] yes. this is for the far future. at the rate we've been going, it's at least six months off.
